title: Migrate Research knowledge and framework integration routes
summary_zh: 將 Research domain 47 個 route decorators 移至 research/router.py，並以 typed route 取代被拆解的 generic aliases。

contracts.research_routes_in_domain_router: RESEARCH_ROUTE_INVENTORY declares and create_research_router registers all 47 assigned Research route method/path pairs in services/control-plane/bff/research/router.py.
contracts.typed_generic_alias_replacements: Typed Research analysis and artifact routes preserve durable source-port reads while the prior generic artifact write aliases fail closed with explicit operation errors.
contracts.inventory_typed_signatures: Every Request-dispatched inventory route is registered with its legacy FastAPI body, path, query, and header signature, so OpenAPI and framework validation remain available without duplicating the durable source-port dispatcher.
contracts.ticket_and_experiment_validation: Ticket priority/status, ticket patch lifecycle, experiment status, and experiment launch run_config validation preserve the legacy fail-closed 422/409 behavior; live experiment execution_mode is rejected.
contracts.source_change_proposal_projection: GET /api/v1/research/source-change-proposals projects the ResearchKnowledgeSourcePort proposals field and reports the port's source and availability in metadata, preserving live proposal records.
contracts.research_note_create_contract: POST /api/v1/knowledge/notes rejects caller-supplied owner_ref, preserves required body and attachment validation, resolves the owner from the authenticated operator, persists a note-{UUID} record, and returns only the legacy 201 create receipt.
contracts.research_note_list_contract: GET /api/v1/knowledge/notes validates attachment filter combinations, filters by owner_ref, attachment_type, attachment_ref, and CSV tags before pagination, and returns the legacy notes/pagination/meta envelope with projected note summaries rather than raw records.
contracts.knowledge_read_contracts: Evidence, insight, and institutional-memory list routes preserve typed query validation, source-port filters, legacy projection and pagination envelopes, availability metadata, and capability-aware evidence redaction rather than exposing raw port records.
contracts.composition_route_contracts: Synthesis conflict-log reads use injected or durable read-adapter seams with stable view projection, while /bff/search preserves its strategy/persona/capital-pool compatibility surface through an injected cross-entity search or typed-port fallback.
contracts.source_port_preservation: The router injects and uses the existing ResearchKnowledgeSourcePort rather than reimplementing reusable source-port logic or falling back to main.py globals.
contracts.composition_boundary: main.py inclusion and deletion of legacy route blocks remain the responsibility of OPGAP-BFF-MAIN-ASSEMBLY-20260830.

verification.result: 12 passed (with one upstream Starlette TestClient deprecation warning)

head_binding_policy: The owner binds the final PR head SHA through REVIEW_HEAD_SHA at handoff. This committed manifest identifies the reviewed scope and evidence but does not claim to contain its own final commit SHA.

This successor retains that repair and extends it to the remaining typed knowledge reads and composition seams, with injected-port exclusion and envelope regressions.
